newsitem.title: UK: Aerodata holds 21.13 pct of Scott Pickford.
newsitem.headline: Aerodata holds 21.13 pct of Scott Pickford.

text.p: Australia's Aerodata Holdings Ltd said on Friday that it had an interest in about 2.67 million shares representing 21.13 percent of the current issued ordinary share capital of British geoscience and engineering services group Scott Pickford.
Aerodata announced on December 13, 1996, that it intended to buy 2.5 million of Scott Pickford's shares at 48 pence each to give it a 20 percent stake.
Scott Pickford would then be offered Aerodata shares giving it 4.3 percent of its share capital. The two companies then intended to pursue joint marketing.
Aerodata said it had received undertakings to accept any offer it may make or be required to make at a price of 48 pence per share for 120,000 shares in Scott Pickford on Friday.
The Australian firm also made a market purchase of 52,000 shares at a price of 48 pence per share on Friday.
The company earlier had 430,000 ordinary shares in Scott Pickford and had also received irrevocable undertakings in respect of about 2.07 million shares in the British firm.
Aerodata said on Friday it would stick to its original plan despite a statement from Scott Pickford earlier today that it had received a bid approach for the whole group.
Scott Pickford's share price was quoted at 51p at 1602 GMT, up 6-1/2p from Thursday.
